git_scope: Blobless clone with a sparse checkout of the scope at the pinned commit for issue #607, the head of master when retrieved. The commit adds only submissions/2026-10-14/ (50 files) to its parent 487b058, the commit whose upper_bounds.json the issue compares against; the index's blob is the same at both commits. The 23 certificates under submissions/2026-10-14/certificates/ are retained as factual data. The submission README, manifest, SHA256SUMS, checker receipts and per-certificate checker logs, the root README and upper_bounds.json are pinned by digest only. The rest of the tree, including 487b058's certificates/ directory, the drawings and the search programs, is pinned by the commit and was not retained or executed.

sources.license: No licence file or reuse terms at the pin: the tree has no LICENSE, and neither README.md nor submissions/2026-10-14/README.md states terms. The 16 campaign and precision certificates are retained as factual data under the owner decision of 2026-10-09 recorded in resources/web/known-best-packings/README.md (Retained Factual Data). The seven composite certificates have the SHA-256 that Kevin Fang's composites/table.csv at TheSnakeFang/squarepack-certs 078789a lists for them, and that repository's README and ATTRIBUTION.md release composites/ under CC0 1.0. Prose is hash-pinned and not copied.
claims: Issue #607 reports seven composites of Kevin Fang's Section 5 table at TheSnakeFang/squarepack-certs 078789a, credited to Fang as their construction author and independently replayed by the reporter: s(703) <= 26.999256308447, s(812) <= 28.988287236851, s(930) <= 30.988287236851, s(931) <= 30.994048655032, s(992) <= 31.997220361783, s(993) <= 31.991327887692 and s(994) <= 31.999256308447; two copied from Fang's shipped certificates and five regenerated with his tools/glue.py, each with the SHA-256 his table lists.
Issue #607 lists two certificate precision refinements separately from the 21 bounds: s(342) <= 18.964706723173 and s(542) <= 23.828427124774.

The checker statements (this repository's sqpack verify.py at 37e6757 and Evan Daniel's verify_cert.py at 622cd2e, and the campaign's Rust rational checker for the 16 campaign and precision certificates) are the author's; no optimality claim is made.
